```{r sports-snc-function, include=FALSE}
compute_sports_snc_for_sample <- function(sample_id, length_df, sample_info_tbl) {
  sample_meta <- sample_info_tbl %>% filter(as.character(Sample) == sample_id) %>% slice(1)
  sample_df <- length_df %>% filter(as.character(Sample) == sample_id)
  if (nrow(sample_df) == 0 || nrow(sample_meta) == 0) {
    return(list(length = tibble(), rsrna_status = tibble(), tsrna_cleavage = tibble()))
  }

  len <- sample_df %>% filter(Class == "Clean_Reads") %>% pull(Length) %>% unique() %>% sort()
  if (length(len) == 0) len <- seq(min(sample_df$Length, na.rm = TRUE), max(sample_df$Length, na.rm = TRUE))
  clean_total <- (sample_df %>% filter(Class == "Clean_Reads") %>% summarise(Total = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>% pull(Total)) %||% 0
  class_text <- sample_df$Class
  is_tsrna_total <- str_detect(class_text, regex("tRNA_Match_Genome|tRNA_Unmatch_Genome", ignore_case = TRUE))
  is_tsrna_5 <- str_detect(class_text, regex("tRNA_5_end_Match_Genome|tRNA_5_end_Unmatch_Genome", ignore_case = TRUE))
  is_tsrna_3 <- str_detect(class_text, regex("tRNA_3_end_Match_Genome|tRNA_3_end_Unmatch_Genome", ignore_case = TRUE))
  is_tsrna_cca <- str_detect(class_text, regex("tRNA_CCA_end_Match_Genome|tRNA_CCA_end_Unmatch_Genome", ignore_case = TRUE))
  is_rsrna <- str_detect(class_text, regex("-rRNA|_rRNA|-YRNA", ignore_case = TRUE)) &
    !str_detect(class_text, regex("antisense|S-rRNA|other-rRNA|YRNA", ignore_case = TRUE))
  is_rsrna_match <- is_rsrna & str_detect(class_text, regex("_Match_Genome", ignore_case = TRUE))
  is_rsrna_unmatch <- is_rsrna & str_detect(class_text, regex("_Unmatch_Genome", ignore_case = TRUE))
  is_unanno_mg <- str_detect(class_text, regex("Unannotated_Match_Genome", ignore_case = TRUE))
  is_unanno_umg <- str_detect(class_text, regex("Unannotated_Unmatch_Genome", ignore_case = TRUE))
  exclusive_sample_df <- sample_df %>%
    filter(!is_tsrna_nested_class(Class), !is_rsrna_nested_length_class(Class))

  classified <- map_dfr(
    setdiff(sports_length_categories, c("other", "unanno_MG", "unanno_UMG")),
    function(category_name) complete_length_series(exclusive_sample_df %>% filter(LengthCategory == category_name), len, category_name, clean_total)
  )
  classified_total <- classified %>%
    group_by(Length) %>%
    summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    right_join(tibble(Length = len), by = "Length") %>%
    mutate(Reads = replace_na(Reads, 0)) %>%
    arrange(Length)
  umg_series <- complete_length_series(sample_df[is_unanno_umg, ], len, "unanno_UMG", clean_total)
  mg_series <- complete_length_series(sample_df[is_unanno_mg, ], len, "unanno_MG", clean_total)
  clean_series <- complete_length_series(sample_df %>% filter(Class == "Clean_Reads"), len, "Clean_Reads", clean_total)
  other_reads <- pmax(clean_series$Reads - classified_total$Reads - umg_series$Reads - mg_series$Reads, 0)
  other_series <- tibble(
    Category = "other",
    Length = len,
    Reads = other_reads,
    RPM = if (clean_total > 0) 1e6 * other_reads / clean_total else rep(0, length(other_reads))
  )
  length_out <- bind_rows(classified, other_series, mg_series, umg_series) %>%
    mutate(
      Sample = sample_id,
      Group = as.character(sample_meta$Group[[1]]),
      Category = factor(Category, levels = sports_length_categories)
    ) %>%
    select(Sample, Group, Category, Length, Reads, RPM)

  rsrna_status <- bind_rows(
    complete_length_series(sample_df[is_rsrna_match, ], len, "Match_Genome", clean_total),
    complete_length_series(sample_df[is_rsrna_unmatch, ], len, "Unmatch_Genome", clean_total)
  ) %>%
    group_by(Category) %>%
    summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), RPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      Sample = sample_id,
      Group = as.character(sample_meta$Group[[1]]),
      GenomeStatus = factor(Category, levels = c("Match_Genome", "Unmatch_Genome")),
      Percent = group_percent(Reads)
    ) %>%
    select(Sample, Group, GenomeStatus, Reads, RPM, Percent)

  tsrna_5 <- complete_length_series(sample_df[is_tsrna_5, ], len, "5'end", clean_total)
  tsrna_3 <- complete_length_series(sample_df[is_tsrna_3, ], len, "3'end", clean_total)
  tsrna_cca <- complete_length_series(sample_df[is_tsrna_cca, ], len, "CCA-end", clean_total)
  tsrna_total <- complete_length_series(sample_df[is_tsrna_total, ], len, "tsRNA", clean_total)
  tsrna_end_sum <- tsrna_5$Reads + tsrna_3$Reads + tsrna_cca$Reads
  if (any(tsrna_end_sum > tsrna_total$Reads + 1, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    stop("tRNA end subsets exceed base totals by more than 1 read in sample ", sample_id)
  }
  tsrna_other_reads <- pmax(tsrna_total$Reads - tsrna_end_sum, 0)
  tsrna_other <- tibble(
    Category = "Internal-other",
    Length = len,
    Reads = tsrna_other_reads,
    RPM = if (clean_total > 0) 1e6 * tsrna_other_reads / clean_total else rep(0, length(tsrna_other_reads))
  )
  tsrna_cleavage <- bind_rows(tsrna_5, tsrna_3, tsrna_cca, tsrna_other) %>%
    group_by(Category) %>%
    summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), RPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      Sample = sample_id,
      Group = as.character(sample_meta$Group[[1]]),
      Cleavage = factor(Category, levels = c("5'end", "3'end", "CCA-end", "Internal-other")),
      Percent = group_percent(Reads)
    ) %>%
    select(Sample, Group, Cleavage, Reads, RPM, Percent)

  list(length = length_out, rsrna_status = rsrna_status, tsrna_cleavage = tsrna_cleavage)
}
```

```{r single-plot-helpers, include=FALSE}
plot_sample_qc <- function(sample_id, tbl) {
  df <- tbl %>%
    filter(as.character(Sample) == sample_id) %>%
    select(Sample, Group, CleanReads, MatchGenome, GenomeRate, DominantCategory, DominantPercent) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(CleanReads, MatchGenome), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Reads")
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(plot_note(sample_id, "No QC data."))
  meta_row <- df %>% slice(1)
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Metric, y = Reads, fill = Metric)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.62) +
    geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(round(Reads, 0))), vjust = -0.35, size = 3.6) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.14))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = mii_qc_palette) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Reads",
      title = paste0(sample_id, " QC"),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Group ", meta_row$Group[[1]],
        " | Genome: ", sprintf("%.2f%%", meta_row$GenomeRate[[1]]),
        " | Dominant: ", meta_row$DominantCategory[[1]],
        " (", sprintf("%.2f%%", meta_row$DominantPercent[[1]]), ")"
      )
    ) +
    mii_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

plot_sports_stacked_length <- function(sample_id, df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0 || sum(df$RPM, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) return(plot_note(sample_id, "No sncRNA length data."))
  plot_df <- df %>% group_by(Category) %>% filter(sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>% ungroup()
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Length, y = RPM, fill = Category)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.9) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = sports_length_palette, drop = TRUE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(plot_df$Length), max(plot_df$Length), by = 5), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.06))) +
    labs(x = "Length", y = "RPM", title = paste(sample_id, "sncRNA length distribution")) +
    mii_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")
}

plot_sports_category_length <- function(sample_id, category_name, df) {
  category_df <- df %>% filter(as.character(Category) == category_name)
  if (nrow(category_df) == 0 || sum(category_df$RPM, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
    return(plot_note(paste(sample_id, category_name), "No length data."))
  }
  ggplot(category_df, aes(x = Length, y = RPM)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.84, fill = sports_length_palette[[category_name]], color = "white", linewidth = 0.12) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(category_df$Length), max(category_df$Length), by = 5), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
    labs(x = "Length", y = "RPM", title = paste(sample_id, category_name, "length distribution")) +
    mii_theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
}

plot_relative_ratios_sample <- function(sample_id, df, view = REPORT_VIEW) {
  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(Sample) == sample_id, Reads > 0) %>%
    mutate(MainCategory = factor(as.character(MainCategory), levels = category_levels))
  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) return(plot_note(paste(sample_id, view), "No ratio data."))
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = MainCategory, y = Percent, fill = MainCategory)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(Percent >= 0.25, sprintf("%.1f", Percent), "")), vjust = -0.25, size = 3.0) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = category_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Percent of clean reads",
      title = paste0(sample_id, " sncRNA relative ratios", view_title_suffix(view))
    ) +
    mii_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))
}

plot_sample_length_all <- function(sample_id, df, view = REPORT_VIEW) {
  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(Sample) == sample_id, RPM > 0) %>%
    filter_direction_view(view) %>%
    mutate(MainCategory = factor(as.character(MainCategory), levels = length_focus_categories))
  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) return(plot_note(paste(sample_id, view), "No length data."))
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Length, y = RPM, color = MainCategory)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.76) +
    scale_color_manual(values = category_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
    labs(
      x = "Length",
      y = "RPM",
      title = paste0(sample_id, " length architecture", view_title_suffix(view))
    ) +
    mii_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")
}

plot_sample_length_category <- function(sample_id, category_name, df, view = REPORT_VIEW) {
  category_df <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(Sample) == sample_id, as.character(MainCategory) == category_name, RPM > 0) %>%
    filter_direction_view(view)
  if (nrow(category_df) == 0) return(plot_note(paste(sample_id, category_name, view), "No length data."))
  ggplot(category_df, aes(x = Length, y = RPM)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.86, color = category_palette[[category_name]]) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
    labs(
      x = "Length",
      y = "RPM",
      title = paste0(sample_id, " ", category_name, " length", view_title_suffix(view))
    ) +
    mii_theme_bw()
}

build_sample_sports_collage <- function(sample_id, df) {
  category_order <- df %>%
    group_by(Category) %>%
    summarise(TotalRPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(TotalRPM > 0, !is.na(Category)) %>%
    arrange(desc(TotalRPM), match(as.character(Category), sports_length_categories)) %>%
    pull(Category) %>%
    as.character()
  build_plot_collage(
    map(category_order, ~plot_sports_category_length(sample_id, .x, df)),
    title_text = paste0(sample_id, " sncRNA length collage"),
    cols = 4
  )
}

build_sample_length_collage <- function(sample_id, df) {
  category_order <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(Sample) == sample_id) %>%
    group_by(MainCategory) %>%
    summarise(TotalRPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(TotalRPM > 0, !is.na(MainCategory)) %>%
    arrange(desc(TotalRPM), match(as.character(MainCategory), length_focus_categories)) %>%
    pull(MainCategory) %>%
    as.character()
  build_plot_collage(
    map(category_order, ~plot_sample_length_category(sample_id, .x, df, view = REPORT_VIEW)),
    title_text = paste0(sample_id, " fitted length collage", view_title_suffix(REPORT_VIEW)),
    cols = 4
  )
}

plot_rsrna_sector_radar_sample <- function(sample_id, rsrna_plot_df, radar_max, radar_breaks, view = REPORT_VIEW) {
  rsrna_radar_angle_offset <- -pi / length(rsrna_radar_levels)
  plot_df <- rsrna_plot_df %>%
    filter(as.character(Sample) == sample_id) %>%
    transmute(PieCategory = as.character(RsRNAClass), Reads, Percent) %>%
    build_sector_radar_df(
      radar_max = radar_max,
      sector_levels = rsrna_radar_levels,
      sector_labels = rsrna_radar_labels,
      sector_palette = rsrna_radar_palette,
      bottom_anchor_category = "18S-rRNA",
      angle_offset = rsrna_radar_angle_offset
    )

  plot_sector_radar_core(
    plot_df = plot_df,
    title_text = paste0("rsRNA Proportion of ", sample_id, view_title_suffix(view)),
    radar_max = radar_max,
    radar_breaks = radar_breaks,
    sector_levels = rsrna_radar_levels,
    sector_palette = rsrna_radar_palette,
    axis_label = "Relative Abundance within total rsRNA (%)"
  )
}

plot_sample_sequence_dominance <- function(sample_id, complexity_tbl) {
  plot_df <- complexity_tbl %>%
    filter(as.character(Sample) == sample_id) %>%
    select(Sample, Group, Top1CleanFraction, Top5CleanFraction, Top10CleanFraction) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(Top1CleanFraction, Top5CleanFraction, Top10CleanFraction),
      names_to = "Metric",
      values_to = "Fraction"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Metric = factor(
        Metric,
        levels = c("Top1CleanFraction", "Top5CleanFraction", "Top10CleanFraction"),
        labels = c("Top 1", "Top 5", "Top 10")
      )
    )

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) return(plot_note(sample_id, "No sequence complexity data."))

  subtitle_row <- complexity_tbl %>% filter(as.character(Sample) == sample_id) %>% slice(1)
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Metric, y = Fraction, fill = Metric)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.62, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(Fraction, accuracy = 0.1)), vjust = -0.35, size = 3.4) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.14))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Top 1" = mii_red, "Top 5" = mii_orange, "Top 10" = mii_blue), drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Fraction of clean reads",
      title = paste0(sample_id, " dominant sequence burden"),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Dominant: ", subtitle_row$DominantAnnotation[[1]],
        " | unique sequences: ", scales::comma(subtitle_row$UniqueSequences[[1]])
      )
    ) +
    mii_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

plot_sample_sequence_rank_curve <- function(sample_id, rank_tbl) {
  plot_df <- rank_tbl %>% filter(as.character(Sample) == sample_id)
  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) return(plot_note(sample_id, "No ranked sequence data."))

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Rank, y = CumulativeFractionOfClean)) +
    geom_line(color = mii_red, linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(color = mii_red, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.75) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(c(1, 5, 10, 20, 50)), minor_breaks = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
    labs(
      x = "Ranked unique sequence",
      y = "Cumulative fraction of clean reads",
      title = paste0(sample_id, " top-sequence accumulation")
    ) +
    mii_theme_bw()
}

plot_sample_length_complexity <- function(sample_id, length_tbl) {
  plot_df <- length_tbl %>% filter(as.character(Sample) == sample_id, Reads > 0)
  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) return(plot_note(sample_id, "No sequence length complexity data."))

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Length, y = UniqueSequences)) +
    geom_col(fill = mii_green, color = "white", linewidth = 0.12, width = 0.86) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
    labs(
      x = "Length",
      y = "Unique sequences",
      title = paste0(sample_id, " sequence complexity by length")
    ) +
    mii_theme_bw()
}
```

```{r raw-fastq-audit-helpers, include=FALSE}
plot_sample_raw_length <- function(sample_id, length_tbl) {
  df <- length_tbl %>% filter(as.character(Sample) == sample_id)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(plot_note(sample_id, "No raw FASTQ length audit data."))
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Length, y = Fraction)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.9, fill = mii_blue) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
    labs(title = paste(sample_id, "raw read length distribution"), x = "Raw read length", y = "Read fraction") +
    mii_theme_bw()
}

plot_sample_raw_end_base <- function(sample_id, end_base_tbl) {
  df <- end_base_tbl %>%
    filter(as.character(Sample) == sample_id) %>%
    mutate(Base = factor(Base, levels = c("A", "C", "G", "T", "N")))
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(plot_note(sample_id, "No raw FASTQ end-base audit data."))
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Base, y = Fraction, fill = Base)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72) +
    facet_wrap(~ End) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(A = mii_green, C = mii_blue, G = mii_orange, T = mii_red, N = mii_neutral_line), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
    labs(title = paste(sample_id, "raw read terminal-base composition"), x = NULL, y = "Read fraction", fill = "Base") +
    mii_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
}

plot_sample_raw_kmer <- function(sample_id, kmer_tbl, top_n = 12L) {
  df <- kmer_tbl %>%
    filter(as.character(Sample) == sample_id) %>%
    group_by(KmerSide) %>%
    arrange(desc(ReadN), Kmer, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(Kmer = factor(Kmer, levels = rev(unique(Kmer))))
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(plot_note(sample_id, "No raw FASTQ k-mer audit data."))
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Kmer, y = Fraction, fill = KmerSide)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72) +
    coord_flip() +
    facet_wrap(~ KmerSide, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(`5prime` = mii_blue, `3prime` = mii_red), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 0.1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
    labs(title = paste(sample_id, "top raw read terminal k-mers"), x = NULL, y = "Read fraction", fill = NULL) +
    mii_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}
```

```{r single-tsrna-data, include=FALSE}
ts_main_counts <- summary_all %>%
  filter(SubClass == "-", str_detect(Class, "^(GtRNAdb|mitotRNAdb)")) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Class) %>%
  summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Class, values_from = Reads, values_fill = 0)

ts_main_wide <- sample_info %>%
  transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample), Group = as.character(Group)) %>%
  left_join(ts_main_counts, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(.x, 0)))

ts_origin_breakdown <- ts_main_wide %>%
  mutate(
    GenomicPreTotal = get_col(., "GtRNAdb-pre-tRNA_Match_Genome") + get_col(., "GtRNAdb-pre-tRNA_Unmatch_Genome"),
    GenomicMatureTotal = get_col(., "GtRNAdb-mature-tRNA_Match_Genome") + get_col(., "GtRNAdb-mature-tRNA_Unmatch_Genome"),
    GenomicFiveEnd = get_col(., "GtRNAdb-mature-tRNA_5_end_Match_Genome") + get_col(., "GtRNAdb-mature-tRNA_5_end_Unmatch_Genome"),
    GenomicThreeEnd = get_col(., "GtRNAdb-mature-tRNA_3_end_Match_Genome") + get_col(., "GtRNAdb-mature-tRNA_3_end_Unmatch_Genome"),
    GenomicCCAEnd = get_col(., "GtRNAdb-mature-tRNA_CCA_end_Match_Genome") + get_col(., "GtRNAdb-mature-tRNA_CCA_end_Unmatch_Genome"),
    GenomicInternal = pmax(GenomicMatureTotal - GenomicFiveEnd - GenomicThreeEnd - GenomicCCAEnd, 0),
    MitoMatureTotal = get_col(., "mitotRNAdb-mature-mt_tRNA_Match_Genome") + get_col(., "mitotRNAdb-mature-mt_tRNA_Unmatch_Genome"),
    MitoFiveEnd = get_col(., "mitotRNAdb-mature-mt_tRNA_5_end_Match_Genome") + get_col(., "mitotRNAdb-mature-mt_tRNA_5_end_Unmatch_Genome"),
    MitoThreeEnd = get_col(., "mitotRNAdb-mature-mt_tRNA_3_end_Match_Genome") + get_col(., "mitotRNAdb-mature-mt_tRNA_3_end_Unmatch_Genome"),
    MitoCCAEnd = get_col(., "mitotRNAdb-mature-mt_tRNA_CCA_end_Match_Genome") + get_col(., "mitotRNAdb-mature-mt_tRNA_CCA_end_Unmatch_Genome"),
    MitoInternal = pmax(MitoMatureTotal - MitoFiveEnd - MitoThreeEnd - MitoCCAEnd, 0),
    Genomic = GenomicPreTotal + GenomicMatureTotal,
    Mitochondrial = MitoMatureTotal
  )

ts_origin_sample <- ts_origin_breakdown %>%
  select(Sample, Group, Genomic, Mitochondrial) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Genomic, Mitochondrial), names_to = "Origin", values_to = "Reads") %>%
  mutate(Origin = recode(Origin, Genomic = "Genomic tRNA", Mitochondrial = "Mitochondrial tRNA")) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group) %>%
  mutate(Percent = group_percent(Reads)) %>%
  ungroup()

ts_genomic_cleavage_sample <- ts_origin_breakdown %>%
  select(Sample, Group, GenomicFiveEnd, GenomicThreeEnd, GenomicCCAEnd, GenomicInternal) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(GenomicFiveEnd, GenomicThreeEnd, GenomicCCAEnd, GenomicInternal), names_to = "Cleavage", values_to = "Reads") %>%
  mutate(
    Cleavage = recode(
      Cleavage,
      GenomicFiveEnd = "Genomic tRNA 5'end",
      GenomicThreeEnd = "Genomic tRNA 3'end",
      GenomicCCAEnd = "Genomic tRNA CCA-end",
      GenomicInternal = "Genomic tRNA internal"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group) %>%
  mutate(Percent = group_percent(Reads)) %>%
  ungroup()

ts_mito_cleavage_sample <- ts_origin_breakdown %>%
  select(Sample, Group, MitoFiveEnd, MitoThreeEnd, MitoCCAEnd, MitoInternal) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(MitoFiveEnd, MitoThreeEnd, MitoCCAEnd, MitoInternal), names_to = "Cleavage", values_to = "Reads") %>%
  mutate(
    Cleavage = recode(
      Cleavage,
      MitoFiveEnd = "Mitochondrial tRNA 5'end",
      MitoThreeEnd = "Mitochondrial tRNA 3'end",
      MitoCCAEnd = "Mitochondrial tRNA CCA-end",
      MitoInternal = "Mitochondrial tRNA internal"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group) %>%
  mutate(Percent = group_percent(Reads)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r processing-report-index, include=FALSE}
processing_report_index <- sample_info %>%
  transmute(
    Sample = as.character(Sample),
    Group = as.character(Group),
    Replicate = as.character(Replicate),
    ProcessingReport = map_chr(Sample, function(sample_id) {
      report_dir <- sports_sample_file(sample_id, "processing_report")
      report_files <- list.files(report_dir, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
      if (length(report_files) == 0) NA_character_ else report_files[[1]]
    })
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ProcessingReportExists = !is.na(ProcessingReport) & file.exists(ProcessingReport),
    ProcessingReportSizeBytes = map_dbl(
      ProcessingReport,
      ~if (!is.na(.x) && file.exists(.x)) file.info(.x)$size else NA_real_
    )
  )
```
